intro.title: Search systems
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple search system that allows users to query a dataset and receive relevant results. You will learn the core concept of implementing a basic search algorithm, focusing on keyword matching and result ranking. The main technologies involved include data structures for storing information and functions to process search queries. By the end, you will understand how search systems work at a fundamental level and be able to create your own basic search functionality.
intro.usecase: Search systems are a foundational component of nearly every modern digital product. They power the core user experience in e-commerce sites like Amazon, content platforms like YouTube, and productivity tools like Slack, where users rely on fast, relevant results to find products, videos, or messages. As a developer, you'll implement these systems to handle features such as autocomplete suggestions, filtering dashboards, or document retrieval, ensuring scalability and performance under heavy user traffic.
